item.title: South Korea's K-ETA exemption runs through Dec 31, 2026
item.description: Your passport doesn't need a K-ETA travel authorization to visit South Korea right now, but that temporary exemption is currently set to end Dec 31, 2026. It has been extended before, but no extension has been announced yet, so check before booking travel for 2027. From The Escape Plan travel data. General information, not legal advice. Always check the official source before you travel.
